name: Wild Princess: A Black Dowry Tale
source:
A young woman is sent to marry the enemy of her people. She leaves her homeland in the care of a group of mercenaries.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一位年輕女子被送去與族人的敵人結婚。她離開故鄉，踏上由一群傭兵護送的旅途。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
